{{Top}}
{{Otheruses|Lock}}
{{Quote|Most cheap locks are designed for show, to discourage typical people from entering private places. They are not designed to keep desperate people out. Rebels are often desperate people.|[[Airen Cracken]]|<ref name="Cracken's Rebel Field Guide">[[Cracken's Rebel Field Guide (sourcebook)|''Cracken's Rebel Field Guide'']]</ref>}}
A '''lock''' was a device that could be used to seal doors, accessways, and windows. Several varieties of lock were available, including electronic locks and [[Magna lock/Legends|magna-locks]].

[[Binders/Legends|Binders]] typically employed simple mechanical locks to secure a [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] within their cuffs.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> Simple bolt locks were used to secure some of the doors present in the [[Command Base]], a [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] installation in the [[Roche asteroid field]].<ref name="SFS">''[[Strike Force: Shantipole]]''</ref>
